text:
maria: Heads-up — PR incoming for a small routing hint header + console UX flag. Proposal: add an ephemeral header `X-Redwood-Route-Hint` to influence route selection and a console toggle to visualize route decisions. Draft: https://go/repro-route-hint-draft
aj: Nice. quick q — how does this interact with quota attribution?
maria: Good q. Header only used for routing decisions. Attribution remains by token/account. We may emit a sampled telemetry field for which route was chosen.
sahil: If we add the header, SDKs need a safe surface. Don't let callers inject raw headers by default. Suggest typed API: `setRouteHint({pool: 'low_latency', affinity: 'soft'})` that maps to internal header.
olivia: Agree. For py/ts expose a typed param; for go use an options/builder pattern. Also we need a deprecation plan for the old explicit routing flag.
aj: Will console show per-pool latency + cost? We should avoid adding a tile that just duplicates existing metrics. Maybe reuse per-route labels in the existing latency/cost panels.
kevin: From SRE POV: ensure route hints can't bypass quota or reserved capacity. Enforcement needs to be in control plane: header must map to a declared policy, otherwise reject or fallback.
maria: Yep — control-plane validation + fallback to default pool. Proposed rollout: feature-flag gated, opt-in for some orgs, then A/B roll to 5% traffic, then 25%.
samir: deploy-bot: feature flag `route_hint_console_v1` enabled for orgs: infra-team, test-org (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
olivia: Docs snippet for SDKs — simple example: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="...", route_hint={"pool": "low_latency"})
resp = client.generate("hello")
```
sahil: Telemetry note: add `route_hint_decision` enum to event schema (values: `default`, `pool:low_latency`, `pool:balanced`, `fallback`). We should version the schema and add migration notes for dashboards.
aj: +1 — gate in SDKs behind a minor version with clear changelog and migration steps. Also call out that route hints are advisory and may be ignored under pressure.
maria: I'll open the RFC PR with control-plane validation, SDK API sketches, telemetry schema, and the rollout plan. Ping me if you want early review. Thanks!
